compensating.why: hop 4 narrows the type it gets to the class itself
hop 2 specializes the type to its class through the type factory
hop 3 keeps the more specific of the type and the unknown type

ownership_reason: Only the gold builds the type of the class: it walks the super-class chain to its root and narrows the root's bare type to the class, so that SimpleType._narrow links the type of every super-class; with the walk omitted it narrows from the bare type of the immediate super-class, whose type then has no super class of its own, and bean introspection (AnnotatedClass._findFields) skips the fields of a type without a super class. Hops 1 and 3 reject Collection and array classes, hops 2 and 4 pass the class along, and every hop returns the type it receives; once that type is built no caller can repair it with the gold's output (SimpleType has no public factory taking a super class, and narrowing a type to its own class returns it unchanged). The convention is pinned outside the gold: a JavaType's super class is the 'fully resolved parent class of this type, if it has one' (JavaType.getSuperClass), and Point has the parent Object; bean introspection finds inherited members only through getSuperClass (ClassUtil.findSuperTypes, used by AnnotatedClass.construct); SimpleType._narrow stitches the full super-class hierarchy of a narrowed SimpleType, and TestSubtypes testIssue1125WithDefault / testIssue1125NonDefault read the properties inherited from two levels up through such types (Default1125 narrowed from Base1125 through Interm1125, TypeDeserializerBase); TypeFactory._fromClass resolves the super class of every class type, recursively. The other DeprecatedTypeHandling1102Test methods use direct children of Object and pass. A one-line edit above the gold that narrows the callee's type of the super-class to the class passes the existing tests but leaves the chain wrong one level further up (C extends B extends A loses A's fields, as on the variant) and, unguarded, makes construct(Object.class) and every interface throw NullPointerException.
